title: Augustana University (Sioux Falls, SD) Accessible Academic Advising A2UI v0.9 Composite Catalog
description: Declarative A2UI v0.9 component catalog aligned with Zion Cloud Solutions' Gemini Enterprise A2UI v0.9 specification ('version': 'v0.9', 4 messages out / 1 action back, 69 composite catalog components) and Augustana University's WCAG 2.2 AA/AAA screen-reader semantics, PMS 282 Navy (#081E3F) & PMS 109 Yellow (#FED102) contrast, non-color status badges, plain-language higher-ed glossary tags, and F-1 international student guardrails.

outboundFromAgent: createSurface (initializes surfaceId, catalogId, and sendDataModel: true)
updateComponents (streams flat component tree with parent/child IDs — legacy alias: surfaceUpdate)
updateDataModel (streams JSON Pointer data state — legacy alias: dataModelUpdate)
deleteSurface (closes surface when advising workflow completes)
inboundFromUser: action (returns action name, surfaceId, sourceComponentId, and resolved context values)

Column.description: Vertical layout container with an accessible region label (Inverted-Pyramid linear reading order).

Row.description: Responsive multi-column split container that pairs a primary DataTable (MaterialTable) with side-by-side DegreeProgressCard or ActionFormCard panels on wide viewports and collapses to a single column at 125%-150% low-vision zoom.

Canvas.description: Gemini Enterprise side-panel Canvas container for side-by-side degree audit simulation, course schedule building, or prerequisite override review.

AlertBanner.description: Visual and screen-reader accessible alert banner with zero audio-only dependencies.

KPIStatRow.description: Grid of key performance indicator cards with non-color delta indicators.

DataTable.description: Accessible semantic HTML table (mapped to Gemini Enterprise MaterialTable) with mandatory screen-reader caption, row header key, Zion Cloud Solutions field mapping, and keyboard-sortable columns.

DegreeProgressCard.description: Accessible progress bars tracking 124-credit degree completion, SOPHIA Core, and F-1 12-credit status.

ActionFormCard.description: Interactive form that emits an A2UI v0.9 action message back to the Google ADK agent on Cloud Run (with server-side Model Armor & RBAC re-validation).

PriorityTradeoffExplorer.description: Liberal Arts Agency & Priority Slicer allowing students to choose how to weight Major/Minor Core, SOPHIA Gen-Ed, and Electives while listing recommended courses per pillar horizontally.

CourseConflictConfigurator.description: Clean dropdown-based course & time-slot selector that lets students swap contested courses (e.g., Major vs. Elective) via native select menus and view plain-text downstream trade-offs.

WeeklyScheduleCalendar.description: Accessible Monday-through-Friday visual calendar grid and converged course schedule summary with live J1 conflict detection (/students/me/schedule-conflicts) and F-1 12-credit full-time guardrails.

ScheduleExportCard.description: One-click export and advisor email approval bar that generates a soft-copy advising plan or opens an email to the assigned advisor without redundant dropdown forms.
